read_ok.note: Long or short when the close breaks, or rejects, the last confirmed pivot high/low (10 bars each side) on volume above 1.5x its 20-day average; 3% take-profit and 2% stop from the signal close, re-issued every bar. Pivots are used only after confirmation. No lookahead. Most trades close the same day through the bracket, filled on 1-minute candles.
Always in the market: flips long/short when the close crosses a band at close +/- 1 ATR(10), a simplified UT Bot. No lookahead.
Long only: buys when RSI(2) was below 25 and turns up while the close is above its 50-day SMA, sells 5 days later. Connors-style dip buying.
Long/short when the close crosses its 50-day SMA; the 'breaker block' filter is almost always true.
Long only while EMA(10) is above EMA(200) on 3-hour bars; fills at the signal bar's close (process_orders_on_close), which in 24/7 crypto is the next bar's open.

No Renko despite the name. Long-only TEMA(5)/SMA(3) cross below a 30-bar SMMA, averaging down up to 100 entries (1% of equity each under the uniform sizing) and closing only when price is 2% above the average entry. It never realises a loss, so its drawdown risk is open-ended.
Long/short on a trailing stop applied to a smoothed Bollinger %B (100 bars, 10 standard deviations). calc_on_order_fills is ignored, the conservative choice.
Long only: buys on Monday when the prior close is below its 30-bar SMA and RSI(3) < 51 (May excluded), exits on the first Wednesday bar. A day-of-week effect.

Long/short when the previous day's last 3-hour Heikin-Ashi close crosses a 30-day EMA of daily Heikin-Ashi closes. Heikin-Ashi values drive signals only; fills are at real prices; the 3-hour value is the last 3-hour bar closed by the daily close (no lookahead).
Noro's Trend Ribbon: long/short when the close breaks the 20-day high or low of a 20-day SMA of OHLC4.
